cards.ex: In this company, you have to toe the line if you want to get promoted; no independent thinking allowed.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyada, agar ko'tarilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidaga rioya qilishingiz kerak; mustaqil fikrlashga ruxsat yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Biror guruhning qoidalariga yoki siyosatiga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: The debate turned into a war of words between the candidates.
cards.exUz: Debat nomzodlar o'rtasida og'zaki urushga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy bahs yoki tortishuv, odatda ommaviy axborot vositalarida.

cards.ex: They had a huge argument, but they're trying to patch things up now.
cards.exUz: Ular juda janjallashishdi, lekin hozir vaziyatni o'nglashga harakat qilishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni tiklash yoki yomon vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The government hoped to use the peace dividend to invest in education and healthcare.
cards.exUz: Hukumat tinchlik dividendidan ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlashga investitsiya qilishga umid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Urush tugaganidan keyin olingan iqtisodiy foyda.

cards.ex: He's always stirring up trouble with his controversial opinions.
cards.exUz: U doimo bahsli fikrlari bilan muammo qo'zg'aydi.

cards.ex: Let's hold fire on making any decisions until we have all the information.
cards.exUz: Keling, barcha ma'lumotlarga ega bo'lmagunimizcha, qaror qabul qilishni to'xtatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishni to'xtatish yoki kechiktirish.

cards.ex: Allowing them this one concession is a slippery slope; they'll want more later.
cards.exUz: Ularga bu birgina imtiyozni berish sirpanchiq yo'l; keyinroq ular ko'proq narsani xohlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat boshqa yomonroq harakatlarga olib kelishi.

cards.ex: It's time to bury the past and move forward.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni unutish va oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammolarni unutish va yangi boshlash.

cards.ex: They fought tooth and nail to keep their business afloat.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z bizneslarini saqlab qolish uchun jon-jahdi bilan kurashishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq kurashmoq, g'alaba qozonish uchun hamma narsani qilish.

cards.ex: Many international organizations are calling for peace in the region.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab xalqaro tashkilotlar mintaqada tinchlikka chaqirmoqda.

cards.ex: The city has been under siege for weeks.
cards.exUz: Shahar bir necha haftadan beri qamal ostida.

cards.ex: The border region is a potential flashpoint between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Chegara hududi ikki davlat o'rtasida potentsial olov nuqtasi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik boshlanishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli joy.

cards.ex: We need to build bridges between different cultures to promote peace.
cards.exUz: Tinchlikni ta'minlash uchun turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida ko'priklar qurishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The protest started peacefully, but it quickly got out of hand.
cards.exUz: Namoyish tinch boshlandi, ammo tezda nazoratdan chiqib ketdi.

cards.ex: The two leaders are at loggerheads over trade policy.
cards.exUz: Ikki lider savdo siyosati bo'yicha kelishmovchilikda.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a war of nerves as each side tried to outwait the other.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar asablar urushiga aylandi, chunki har bir tomon boshqasini kutishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Psixologik bosim orqali g'alaba qozonishga urinish.

cards.ex: The senators crossed swords over the proposed budget cuts.
cards.exUz: Senatorlar taklif qilingan byudjet qisqartirishlari bo'yicha bahslashdi.

cards.ex: Both sides have signed a truce agreement to allow humanitarian aid to reach the affected areas.
cards.exUz: Har ikki tomon jabrlangan hududlarga gumanitar yordam etkazish uchun sulh kelishuviga imzo chekdilar.

cards.ex: Their policies sowed the seeds of future conflict.
cards.exUz: Ularning siyosatlari kelajakdagi mojaroning urug'ini sepdi.

cards.ex: He sent her flowers as a peace offering after their argument.
cards.exUz: U janjaldan keyin unga sulh taklifi sifatida gul yubordi.

cards.ex: The country is in a state of unrest following the election results.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalaridan so'ng mamlakat bezovtalik holatida.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsizliklar va noroziliklar bilan tavsiflangan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread.
cards.exUz: Bu mish-mishlar tarqalishidan oldin, biz ularni chechakda so'ldirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The trade dispute has broken down relations between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Savdo bahsi ikki davlat o'rtasidagi munosabatlarni buzdi.

cards.ex: Military intervention should be a last resort.
cards.exUz: Harbiy aralashuv oxirgi chora bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Faqat boshqa imkoniyat qolmaganda qilinadigan narsa.

cards.ex: Could you lower the tone? We're trying to have a civilized discussion here.
cards.exUz: Ohangni pasaytira olasizmi? Biz bu yerda madaniy munozara o'tkazmoqchimiz.

cards.ex: His statement only muddied the waters further.
cards.exUz: Uning bayonoti vaziyatni yanada chalkashtirib yubordi.

cards.ex: The media coverage only fanned the flames of public anger.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining yoritilishi faqat jamoatchilik g'azabining olovini alangalatdi.

cards.ex: We need to support the doctors and nurses who are in the trenches fighting this pandemic.
cards.exUz: Biz bu pandemiyaga qarshi xandaqlarda kurashayotgan shifokorlar va hamshiralarni qo'llab-quvvatlashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The negotiators are trying to seek common ground to end the conflict.
cards.exUz: Muzokarachilar mojaroni tugatish uchun umumiy til topishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishish uchun umumiy fikrlarni topishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Neither side is willing to back down from their demands.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon o'z talablaridan chekinishni istamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Da'vodan voz kechmoq yoki bahsda yutqazishni tan olmoq.
